name: special-teams
goal: The two pure modules of the Kimi special-teams harness: st_schema checks a model's native tool calls before anything runs (Continual Harness saw one malformed call repeated 1,003 times), st_mission guards the mission (allowed tools, URL allowlist, step/action budgets, repeats) against Kimi's known excessive proactiveness. First campaign on personnel-fitted budgets (no requests_per_attempt).

tasks.instructions: Error strings are part of the API: copy their wording from the contract exactly, including quotes. In validate_args report required-missing first, then walk args in their own order. bool is not an integer or a number.
tasks.test_instructions: Assert the exact error strings from the contract. Cover: JSON string vs dict arguments, empty arguments, invalid JSON, non-object JSON, missing name, integer/number refusing bool, enum only after the type is right, additionalProperties absent vs false, unknown tool listing sorted names, a tool without parameters.

tasks.instructions: check() returns the FIRST refusal in the contract's numbered order and counts it; an allowed check changes nothing. Repeats count RECORDED calls only, keyed by name plus json.dumps(args, sort_keys=True). url_allowed never raises: bad input is False. file: paths compare case-insensitively, http paths case-sensitively.
tasks.test_instructions: Walk the contract example line by line. Cover refusal order (step budget, then tool, then action budget, then url, then repeats), encoded ../, folder prefixes ending in /, netloc and scheme mismatches, refused-in-a-row reset by record(), and the summary() dict exactly.
